name: Cotabato City
registryBasis: The official Geoportal Philippines layer catalogue exposes a national Land Management Bureau (LMB) parcel-data layer, but no Cotabato City local cadastral custodian or city-specific public parcel procedure was verified. The City Planning page was found but did not expose a parcel service in this attempt.

queries.query: Cotabato City official cadastral parcel map GIS Philippines
queries.result: Found official Geoportal Philippines, its Parcel data catalogue entry, an LMB cadastral-map FOI record mentioning Cotabato City, the official Cotabato City Planning page, and a NAMRIA Cotabato City geodetic-station page. No bounded anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: Cotabato City opisyal mapa cadastral lupa parcel Philippines
queries.result: Search results repeated official Philippine Geoportal and LMB cadastral-map material; no city-local public parcel API or safe parcel geometry response was exposed.

source.name: Geoportal Philippines / Parcel data
source.operator: Land Management Bureau (LMB), as labelled by the official Geoportal layer catalogue
source.scope: National Geoportal catalogue entry labelled Parcel data; Cotabato City coverage and citywide completeness were not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Geoportal Philippines national Parcel data layer.
coverageAssessment.exactPointResult: No exact-point parcel response was obtained; timeout is not evidence of absence.

remainingUncertainty: The current Geoportal JavaScript/configuration was inspected and identified /layers/fetchlayers, the LMB denr_parcel_data layer, and its GeoServer WMS endpoint. Layer metadata returned successfully. Bounded WFS GetCapabilities, WFS GetFeature with a small Cotabato bbox, and WMS GetFeatureInfo requests timed out without a response, so schema, CRS, native parcel fields, geometry, and city coverage remain unresolved.
notes: Packet completion records executed research only; it is not source integration or admission. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception were used.
